# Degitide

> Degitide saves DEGIRO holdings and transactions on your own server. Use its dashboard or CLI to follow multiple accounts, compare holdings value with net invested, and export your history.

The public website is an interactive demo with fictional holdings. To connect a real account, run Degitide on your own computer or VPS. [Source code](https://github.com/tatoalo/degitide) and [release downloads](https://github.com/tatoalo/degitide/releases) are public.

## Product and setup

To read the full guide directly, request `https://degitide.trade/` with `Accept: text/markdown`.

- [Full guide in Markdown](https://degitide.trade/llms-full.txt) covers installation, sync timing, P&L, exports, the policy proxy, and one-way imports into Sure.
- [Portfolio demo](https://degitide.trade/#portfolio) lets you switch between sample accounts and inspect the chart.
- [Architecture](https://degitide.trade/#architecture) shows a portfolio sync, a blocked order request, and Sure reading a saved snapshot.
- [Get started](https://degitide.trade/#setup) has the Docker commands for an existing source checkout.
- [Set up with an agent](https://degitide.trade/#agent-setup) opens the installation prompt in Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor. The same [plain-text setup prompt](https://degitide.trade/setup-prompt.txt) works with another agent that has terminal access.
- [Common questions](https://degitide.trade/#questions) covers data storage, background sync, and trading limits.

## Project

- [Alessandro Pogliaghi](https://apogliaghi.com/) built Degitide independently of DEGIRO.
- [Contact Alessandro](https://apogliaghi.com/contact/) for questions about the project.
